description: Epistemology decomposed. Post-Gettier responses (no-false-lemmas, sensitivity, safety, virtue), evidentialism, contextualism, social epistemology, testimony, peer disagreement, naturalised epistemology, skeptical hypotheses.

sub_mechanisms.name: no_false_lemmas_response
sub_mechanisms.definition: Add: belief not based on any false intermediate. Closes some Gettier cases.
sub_mechanisms.why: Earliest Gettier fix. Standard textbook response. Cost: not all Gettier cases involve false lemmas.

sub_mechanisms.name: sensitivity_condition
sub_mechanisms.definition: Nozick: belief sensitive iff would not believe were it not true. Closure-violating.
sub_mechanisms.why: Counterfactual analysis. Handles Gettier but creates new problems (closure failure). Influential.

sub_mechanisms.name: safety_condition
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sosa: belief safe iff couldn't easily have been wrong. Preserves closure.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern replacement for sensitivity. Standard in contemporary epistemology. Robust + intuitive.

sub_mechanisms.name: virtue_epistemology
sub_mechanisms.definition: Knowledge = belief produced by intellectual virtues (Sosa, Zagzebski).
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern framework. Cognitive character central. Influence on ethics of belief, education.

sub_mechanisms.name: evidentialism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Beliefs justified iff fit total evidence. Feldman + Conee.
sub_mechanisms.why: Internalist mainstream. Foundation of contemporary epistemology of evidence. Cost: nature of 'evidence' contested.

sub_mechanisms.name: contextualism_knowledge
sub_mechanisms.definition: Knowledge attributions context-sensitive. 'Knows' changes meaning with stakes.
sub_mechanisms.why: DeRose, Cohen. Handles skeptical pressure. 'I know I have hands' (normal context); 'I don't know I'm not a BIV' (skeptical context).

sub_mechanisms.name: social_epistemology
sub_mechanisms.definition: Epistemology of testimony, expertise, scientific communities, online discourse.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern subdiscipline. Bulk of beliefs from testimony. Goldman, Coady. Critical for AI: testimony from machines.

sub_mechanisms.name: testimony_problem
sub_mechanisms.definition: When justified in believing what another tells me? Reductionism (need independent reasons) vs anti-reductionism.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation social epistemology. Coady defends anti-reductionism: testimony basic source. Importance for science + AI.

sub_mechanisms.name: peer_disagreement
sub_mechanisms.definition: Epistemic peers disagree: should one revise? Conciliationism vs steadfast view.
sub_mechanisms.why: Contemporary debate. Conciliation: lower confidence; steadfast: maintain. Implications: science, politics, expertise.

sub_mechanisms.name: naturalised_epistemology
sub_mechanisms.definition: Quine: epistemology should be empirical study of how brains form beliefs. Replace philosophy with psychology.
sub_mechanisms.why: Radical proposal. Influence: empirical turn in epistemology. Cognitive science of belief. Cost: normative loss.

sub_mechanisms.name: BIV_brain_in_vat
sub_mechanisms.definition: You might be a brain in vat being fed simulated experience. Modern Cartesian doubt.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard skeptical scenario. Putnam: BIV hypothesis self-defeating (semantic externalism). Foundation of modern skepticism debate.

sub_mechanisms.name: simulation_hypothesis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Bostrom: probably we're in a simulation. Either civilisations don't reach simulation stage, or don't run sims, or we're sims.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern variant of Cartesian doubt. Engages physicalist intuitions. Practical impact: limited; philosophical: real.

derivation_rules.name: safety_modern_standard_post_Gettier
derivation_rules.why: Better than sensitivity (preserves closure). Handles Gettier. Standard in contemporary analytic epistemology.

derivation_rules.name: contextualism_handles_skeptic
derivation_rules.why: Saves ordinary knowledge claims while respecting skeptical force. Cost: semantic surprising. Standard contemporary response.

derivation_rules.name: testimony_basic_or_inferential_open
then: epistemological status depends on reductionism vs anti-reductionism
derivation_rules.why: Reductionists need independent reason; anti-reductionists treat testimony as basic. Contemporary social epistemology core question.

derivation_rules.name: peer_disagreement_conciliation_evidence
then: under conciliationism, you should lower confidence
derivation_rules.why: Peer disagreement = evidence that you might be wrong. Steadfasters disagree. Contemporary debate; affects expertise + science.

derivation_rules.name: naturalised_epistemology_replaces_normative
derivation_rules.why: Quine: 'epistemology becomes psychology'. Critics: loses normative force. Modern: both descriptive + normative coexist.
